task: Task 7 - Final Production Audit and Cleanup Plan
summary: Core PDF, image, Excel, CSV, mapping, ERP resolution, and quality-gate tests pass. Production release is blocked by validation bypasses in legacy export/fill routes, unsafe download-path handling, and an uncommitted release state.
critical_blockers: Legacy /api/v1/forms/export/pdf and /api/v1/forms/export/excel accept client-controlled skip_validation and can bypass the Task 6 export pre-check.
/api/v1/fill/ maps and exports without the Task 6 export pre-check, creating a second gate bypass.
The working tree contains modified and untracked production source, migration, test, and report files; the tested release is not reproducible from a committed revision.
Fill job responses expose server output_path values and download trusts the stored path without proving containment beneath the configured export directory.
non_critical_risks: Backup files remain in app, frontend, tests, and alembic/versions.
0007 and 0008 downgrade paths need staging restore/downgrade testing before production use.
OCR_RESULT_CACHE is unbounded and OCR/native processing can block the single application worker.
CSV and XLSX parsers materialize input rows before applying the normalized 5000-row limit.
Uploads and generated exports have no verified general retention job and are accumulating.
The 7227-line frontend/index.html has high maintenance and regression risk.
Business/OCR data is persisted in browser localStorage without a documented expiry policy.
E2E covers four PDFs and legacy exports, but not image, XLSX, CSV, workbench pre-check, JSON export, or browser UI flows.
Test warnings include an un-awaited mock coroutine and pytest-asyncio loop-scope deprecation.
Docker Compose contains a weak development database password and must not be used unchanged in production.
README/API guidance still emphasizes legacy fill/export routes instead of the gated workbench flow.

responsibilities.ocr: File validation, OCR extraction, classification, and job processing.
responsibilities.company_form_mapper: Document classification and ERP form field/row mapping.
responsibilities.erp_master_resolver: Scoped customer, supplier, and product resolution.
responsibilities.export_precheck: Required-field, confidence, master, row, and quality gate evaluation.
responsibilities.exporters: JSON, Excel, and PDF artifact generation.

risks: workbench_correction_apply imports router helpers from forms.py, reversing the intended dependency direction.
Broad exception fallbacks can hide correction, template, validation, and resolver failures.
Normalization and alias helpers are duplicated across forms, mapper, normalizers, parser, and pre-check modules.
company_form_mapper.py and forms.py contain large functions and broad responsibilities.

database_alembic.compatibility: Current database is at the sole head and passed the required test suite.
database_alembic.downgrade_risk: 0007 does not fully restore prior company_id constraints; 0008 may fail when reverting data that uses newly allowed master types.

risks: One legacy upload accept list omits XLSX/CSV
Sensitive business data may persist in localStorage

security_notes: Production settings reject weak JWT secrets and wildcard CORS.
Uploads enforce extension/MIME/signature, size, image-dimension, and PDF-page checks.
Do not expose or commit .env; it is currently ignored.
Add rate limiting/login abuse controls, path containment, retention policies, and sensitive-log review before release.
Raw OCR is available to authorized review endpoints and therefore requires explicit access and retention policy.
performance_notes: A single worker executes blocking OCR/native workloads.
Timeout cancellation may not stop underlying native OCR work.
Whole uploads and tabular inputs can be materialized in memory.
ERP matching is in-memory O(rows multiplied by candidate mappings).
Unbounded cache and accumulated upload/output files increase memory and disk risk.
safe_cleanup_candidates: Move *.before-* and other backup copies from app, frontend, tests, and alembic/versions into a dated backups archive after checksums.
Archive or remove obsolete logs, verification outputs, browser profiles, downloads, and scratch files after ownership review.
Retire duplicate virtual environments only after confirming .venv311 is the supported environment.
Apply a documented retention policy to uploads and output; do not blanket-delete them.
Move historical task reports to docs/reports after preserving links.
do_not_delete: Active app source, including export_precheck_engine.py and tabular_document_parser.py.
Task 4, 5, and 6 tests and their active fixtures.
e2e_runner.py, even though current ignore rules may exclude it.
.env from deployed hosts; keep it secret and uncommitted.
templates_store, current database files/data, uploads, or output before retention/legal review.
Docker, environment examples, start scripts, and current operational documentation.
release_gates: Remove all client-controlled validation bypasses and route every export path through one pre-check contract.
Constrain downloads to the configured output directory and stop exposing absolute server paths.
Commit/review the exact tested source and migration set, then build from a clean checkout.
Add integration/E2E coverage for workbench blocked and allowed exports across JSON, Excel, and PDF.
Define upload/export retention, production secrets, worker sizing, and rollback procedure.
